title: Forge Hub | Auto Paint, Seeker Ragebot, Trolling & More
features:
DASHBOARD
- Live round, role and player stats
- Activity feed showing everything as it happens

CAMOUFLAGE
- Auto blend into the surface around you (adjustable speed)
- Paint your body any colour for free
- Rainbow body (adjustable speed)
- Pattern blend for textured walls
- Save and reapply your favourite paints
- Eyedropper to grab any colour off the map (auto paint option)

UTILITY
- Pose lock to stay perfectly still
- Ground bury to hide inside the floor (adjustable depth)
- Auto taunt (custom timing)
- Play any emote on loop
- Spin bot (custom speed)
- Spam every emote at once (custom speed)

COMBAT
- Silent aim to tag any hider from anywhere
- Auto fire on your target (custom speed)
- Target by nearest, crosshair or lowest health
- On screen FOV circle
- Kill every hider instantly
- Auto kill all through the seek phase
- Triggerbot with an optional hold key
- Decoy tracers to confuse hiders (custom rate)
- Fake aim angles with optional jitter
- Fake crouch

LOADOUT
- Equip any gun skin
- Claim the group gun
- Force yourself onto the seeker team

ESP
- See every hider and seeker through walls (custom colours)
- Chams
- Name, role and distance tags
- Reveal hidden and invisible players
- Answer check showing who survived and who died

CAMERA
- Freecam to fly the whole map (custom speed and view)
- Spectate any player
- Third person unlock (custom zoom)
- Custom field of view

CHARACTER
- Custom walk speed and jump power
- Infinite jump
- Noclip
- Fly (custom speed)
- Fly up through ceilings
- Bring back wall climbing
- AFK mode
- Votekick alerts with auto server hop

ROUND CONTROL (private server host)
- Set the hide and seek timers
- Pick the gamemode and map
- Start, stop and skip rounds

SETTINGS
- Disable paint features while in the lobby
- Custom menu and panic keybinds
- FPS booster
- Unlock FPS cap
- Anti AFK
- Server hop and instant rejoin
